text: Skinny guy, you want muscle? Eat everything, gain a ton of weight, then cut. It's the only way!
Bulk, then cut. Is it really the only way?
A review looked at people who lifted weights while eating enough protein.
Beginners, people returning to the gym, and people with more body fat could build muscle and lose fat at the same time.
New to the gym? Lift hard, eat your protein, and skip the dirty bulk. Save this.
